claims.statement: The derivations use Hu and Kirkland's Theorem 3.2.3 for simple random walks with the source's complete multipartite sums including all singleton parts.

Separate source-derived reconstruction and the portable integer checker establish the fixed certificate identity. The independent proof justifies denominator positivity and the finite-support lemma for every number of parts.
The independently reconstructed five-gap polynomial has 1777 positive coefficients, minimum 2, constant 60948, and weighted gap degree 5.
For r>=3,p>=1,q_i>=3, every missing edge within every minimum-size non-singleton part of K_(q_1,...,q_r) join K_p strictly decreases the simple-random-walk Kemeny constant.

supports.locator: contains:every pair in every minimum part

claims.statement: Independent rational subtraction and the portable exact cross-multiplication checker verify the ranking identity; the independent review proves both positivity inequalities on the full eligible domain.
In a connected complete multipartite graph, sign(Delta_x-Delta_y)=sign(x-y) for two parts x,y>=3; arbitrary other positive integer part sizes.
In the improvement theorem graph family, any edge within any smallest non-singleton part is a globally optimal single missing-edge insertion and strictly decreases K.
Hu and Kirkland state the r>=3 exclusion as Conjecture 3.4.7 in the pinned 2019 manuscript, PDF page19.
The accepted universal minimum-part theorem proves every r>=3,p>=1 case of that conjectural assertion; strict ranking strengthens the edge-choice conclusion.
Inspected later twin-clique, tree-edge and stochastic-completion results do not supply this all-r,all-p single-unit-edge sign theorem; the general update machinery is prior work.

The named-conjecture comparison and independent review support a nontrivial original research contribution against the inspected literature. This is not an exhaustive priority or first-proof assertion.
The canonical release checks reconstruct 1777 exact positive coefficients, constant60948, maximum gap degree5, and validate the ranking identity.
The inspected arXiv2608.04150v1 Example4.8 states clique order33 maximizes the K90,10 increase; the preceding simplification has a denominator discrepancy.
For K90,10 all89 integer clique orders2..90 have unique maximizer28, maximum increase1008/1349, and gap201710/6902833 over order33; independent full-matrix checks confirm the comparison.

The portable correction checker preserves the audited quotient/principal-minor calculation and all omitted eigenmodes; an independent evaluator uses characteristic coefficients and two full100x100 inverses.
The deterministic renderer checks every local paper link and fragment and emits exactly one h1.
README and GitHub Pages paper share one deterministic source; mathematical expressions are protected before Markdown conversion.
